positions.title: Engineer Lead, Requisition Services
positions.description:
•	Led an engineering team located in India.  Trained new engineers on the Requisition Services ecosystem.  Conducted daily meetings to provide technical details and design direction.  Conducted design and code reviews ensuring product correctness.   
•	Worked with the Product Owner to determine product direction and product requirements.  
•	Determined design and direction to implement product requirements. 
•	Directed team members to implement the product requirements in the Requisition Services environment.
•	Researched and identified areas to reduce AWS cost within the Requisition Services environment.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Job Distribution Team - Maintained the information needed for job postings and associated business logic.  Major projects include:

•	Job Cache - Developed RESTful API and microservice designed to move serialized job data from in house front end servers to the AWS cloud. Technologies included the Sinatra/Ruby API, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, AWS Redis ElastiCache, AWS Simple Notification Service (SNS), C#, VB.NET 
•	Job Attributes API - Developed a RESTful API which provided a standard interface for internal customers to obtain job posting data.  Technologies included Microsoft MVC Web API in C# and MSSQL.
•	Job Geography Modernization - Refactored CareerBuilder’s standard application for accessing location information to use a new internal interface based upon Google’s API.  Effort involved reconciling internal requirements and close coordination with internal customers.  Implementation required resolving internal references in entire CareerBuilder on platform C# and VB.NET application.
•	Job Distribution UX - Developed components for examining status of multiple cloud Job Distribution applications.  Developed using Ruby on Rails, AWS SDK toolkit, HTML, CSS and PostgreSQL, PagerDuty and New Relic supplied APIs. 
•	Paperboy - Designed and developed a RESTful API and supporting gems to heuristically determine what jobs should be sent to which CareerBuilder specialty sites.  Technologies include Sinatra / Ruby and MongoDB.

In addition to discrete tasks for each team, duties included resolving customer reported issues, modifying frontend pages using HTML and CSS, creating database schemas using MS SQL server, participating in design and product sprints using Agile based processes, mentoring high school interns through CareerBuildHer.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Talent Network Team – Talent Networks were customer branded job seeker websites that were fully customizable as to customer specifications by using a variety of templates.  Major projects include:

•	Fulfillment Tool - The fulfillment tool is used by internal customers to create templated Talent Networks for clients.  In addition to new features created in VB.net and C#, increased product reliability through Selenium testing and application logging.
•	Language Translator Tool – Provides language translations for Talent Network elements in the language that the user specifies.  Effort was developed in VB.NET and C#.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed real-time, embedded software for a software defined radio.  The projects were developed on a VxWorks platform in C and C++.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed real-time, safety critical software on Unix and VxWorks platforms using C/C++ programming languages.
